title: Channel Content
description: One post, for one channel, adapted by SNS Content Agent (A10) from Master Content. One Master Content typically yields 2-5 of these, not nine. A10 never posts: every artifact requires individual human approval, and approving a Repurpose Plan is not approving its posts. Compliance applies to every surface here, including on-screen text, thumbnails, and hashtags.

channel.description: Pinterest and email newsletter are out of scope for this agent.

target_persona.description: Who on THIS channel this post is for. Differs by channel for the same piece.

objective.description: Exactly one. The post is measured against this objective, not against reach. Judging Instagram by reach or X by follower count produces the wrong content.

hook.description: The opening. Highest-risk element in the artifact: compression is where guarantees appear. A concrete first-hand observation is the strongest hook available to this account and the one no competitor can copy.

body.description: Channel-native. Must be whole on its own: a reader who never opens the article should still receive something complete.

hashtags.description: In scope for compliance. #願いが叶う / #絶対当たる / #運気アップ確実 are blocking violations.

character_limit.description: The channel/format budget this asset must fit.

visual_direction.description: Instagram, Facebook, Ameba, note. References CLEARED inventory by id. Never describes an image to be generated: AI imagery depicting a real shrine is a fabrication of the same weight as an invented paragraph.

asset_reference.description: Id from the cleared photo inventory. Never a generation prompt.

on_image_text.description: In scope for compliance. A slide reading 願いが叶う is a violation regardless of the caption.

photo_permission_status.description: 'pending' blocks the entire visual channel for this piece, not just the affected slide.

video_direction.description: TikTok, YouTube, Shorts. Every beat references real visit footage by id.

title.description: In scope for compliance. No fear framing, no clickbait promise.

thumbnail_text.description: In scope for compliance. A compliant video under a fear-framed thumbnail is a violation.

footage_reference.description: Id from cleared footage inventory. Never 'b-roll of a shrine'.

on_screen_text.description: In scope for compliance. If a judgment's attribution marker does not fit the frame, the judgment does not go in the frame.

audio_licence_confirmed.description: Third-party music requires a confirmed licence.

thread_posts.description: X threads. Post 1 must stand alone; each subsequent post adds rather than continuing a sentence. Assume every post travels alone when quoted.

firsthand_claims.description: Every first-hand statement in this post, with the source it came from. A social post is a publication and carries the same evidentiary weight as an article.

source_reference.description: Must resolve to an entry in the Master Content source_map.

attribution_markers.description: Markers used in this asset. Judgments carry their marker on every channel, including inside short frames.

disclaimer.description: Required in the channel's native form on any post carrying a divinatory judgment. Never a licence for a stronger claim above it.

all_surfaces_swept.description: hook, body, CTA, hashtags, on-screen text, slide text, thumbnail, video title, description.

disclosure_required.description: Sponsored or gifted content disclosure per 景品表示法 / ステマ規制, in the post itself.

requires_compliance_review.description: Always true for LINE, without exception. Also true for any post carrying a judgment, entering a sensitive domain, or using a hook under ~3 seconds / ~20 characters.

human_approval_required.description: Always true. There is no design in which A10 posts autonomously.

status.description: A10 may set ready_for_qa. It may never set approved or posted.
